notes.title: Another patch and more news about the demo
notes.content:
Greetings everybody!

We have recently published another patch to improve your experience in our demo for Archer: The Witch's Wrath. Check out the changelog below:


 Improved the shop menu, it should no longer be possible to purchase arrows for free after restarting the game
 Archer allies AI improved and damage output increased
 Added missing SFX to Orc Champion
 Added missing sword SFX
 Increased game stability

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601925/263155ff3c2b9c062f127cdd9a20c7b6a0cdb81a.png

Steam Next Fest is slowly drawing to a close. Thank you for the valuable feedback, we read every comment and took it to heart. This demo is but a small glimpse into the game we want to create and there is a lot of room for improvements and changes. Our main goal when publishing our demo was to establish which game aspects we should focus on or modify. And thanks to your support, we now have all the info we need to create a better game. Thank you!

We will keep the demo public for now, even after the Steam Next Fest ends. If you have any afterthoughts, feel free to share them with us on the forums!

Happy hunting!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1175350/Archer_The_Witchs_Wrath/

notes.title: New patch for Archer: The Witch's Wrath demo!
notes.content:
Greetings everybody!

As you probably noticed, we launched our demo as part of this edition of Steam Next Fest! We're very excited to showcase our small preview version of Arche and we hope that you're having a fun time playing it.

In order to make your experience even better, we just release a patch for our demo. You can check out the changelog below:


 Implemented a new type of enemy - a healing monster that spawns in later waves
 Improved Ork pathing
 Fixed crashes that would sometimes happen after orcs killed a peasant
 SteamVR should no longer activate when you launch the demo
 Removed motion blur by popular demand
 Improved map borders
 Added a warning when the orcs attack the villagers

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601925/bde85d87e4e6048c49e24cc53198ae3322a6e774.png

If you run into any issues or have any other comments or suggestions, please let us know! We also encourage you to join our Discord channel. We would love to hear from you!

Happy hunting!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1175350/Archer_The_Witchs_Wrath/

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Archery techniques and various arrows
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601925/161fb4e07b92660b0c213022dcd0d0c22f8ce1be.png

Hello archers!

Phew! It’s been a while since our last devlog! We’d like to catch up and present you with information about recent progress on our game - Archer: The Witch's Wrath! Our main topic this time will be the archery system.

We have not been dragging our feet when it comes to new features. First of all, we are well aware that archery isn’t limited to one technique. You can use different bows, choose from a variety of arrows, or - obviously - shoot in different ways. We want to give players the freedom of choice; the technique they decide to use will depend on their convenience and needs. The game will give them a chance to experiment with archery, therefore they will learn which style suits them best in practice. We will provide players with opportunities to prove themselves, no matter which path they took.

Speaking about shooting, these are some of the techniques you will be able to learn.

🏹 Basic shot - the simplest and fastest technique, where accuracy is less important than the rate of fire; it should be used for short or medium distances.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601925/01b4c92a52d4d8678638ab2a1a463b675efceb6f.jpg

🏹 Double shot - an alternate version of the basic shot, the difference is that the archer fires two arrows at once; an accurate shot deals double damage, which makes defeating your opponents easier, but on the other hand, player loses arrows faster.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601925/9b1798063fe059b0c6eb5721c4e09f487daf7c7a.jpg

🏹 Precise shot - this technique is much slower, but makes aiming easier; your character focuses, the camera zooms on the target, and time slows down - in such conditions, the player can shoot more consciously and aim for more vulnerable parts (such as head, which take more damage).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601925/7ff79fcd1d29bbcfd683813c80554d762e46a6d1.jpg

🏹 Quick burst - it is the fastest way to shoot; when aiming, archer focuses (just like with the precise shot), marking up to three targets. Then, three shots are fired at the pointed enemies. Unfortunately, this technique cannot be used constantly, since it has a fairly long cooldown. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601925/b72439af0379964e95415374bac0c6aa0d6ce473.jpg

We have mentioned before that shooting techniques will be influenced by arrows. We implemented many types of them in the game. Each will work differently in specific conditions and some will only be useful in exceptional situations. The player can use any type of arrow in each of the techniques we discussed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601925/703053cba29b459f5c8c244a9279393f209b2f46.png

🏹 Regular arrow – an ordinary arrow; deals normal damage to all enemies except armored ones - it does only half the damage to them. 
🏹 Piercing arrow – a special arrow for monsters with heavy armor; it can penetrate the target, dealing full damage to armored enemies.
🏹 Fire arrow – deals additional fire damage; there’s also a chance for setting the target on fire.
🏹 Poison arrow – an arrow that poisons its target, dealing additional damage from poison every second until death.
🏹 Explosive arrow – it doesn’t have to hit opponents directly; the explosion deals area damage, so it’s best used against groups of enemies. Additionally, there is a chance of knocking down or stunning enemies.
🏹 Magic arrow – an arrow that allows players to take control over opponents; although the effect wears off after several seconds.
🏹 Wolf arrow – when fired, this arrow turns into a wolf that charges at your enemies and goes for the throat - it keeps monsters distracted, as they’re focusing on the wolf. The animal will fight to its death.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37601925/31631dbd4287fbf5aa728e56cfa4b27004c323dc.jpg

What do you think? Should we include anything else, to make archery in our game even more immersive? We can’t wait to hear your opinions and suggestions regarding the mechanics described above. 

See you on the next devlog!

Cheers,
Image Power Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1175350/Archer_The_Witchs_Wrath/
